docs.summary: A world-space convex prism that stamps an area over already-rasterized geometry during a bake (the payload of [`NavMeshModifierVolume`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshModifierVolume), applied via Recast's convex volume marking). Self-contained — no Transform or component references — so it is safe to hand to a background build alongside [`NavMeshGeometrySource`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshGeometrySource)s. A volume only re-marks voxels that geometry produced; it never creates walkable surface on its own, and an [`NotWalkable`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAreas~NotWalkable) volume erases walkability inside its footprint.
World-space convex footprint polygon; only X/Z are used.
Vertical extent of the prism, in world space.

The area stamped inside the volume (see [`NavMeshAreas`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.NavMeshAreas)).

docs.summary: Build the volume for an oriented box (local center/size under a world transform): the 8 corners are transformed, the vertical range is their Y span, and the footprint is the convex hull of their XZ projection. Yaw-only boxes yield a 4-gon; arbitrary rotations project to up-to-6-gons, which stay convex and are marked exactly.
